Usage follows the deal's Contract Usage Timeframe: Monthly = last full month vs. the monthly limit; Quarterly / Bi-Yearly / Yearly = the current contract period counted from the license start, usage to date plus a pace projection (shown as ~x % while the period runs); Full Contract = license start to end · MRR = monthly value of every live won deal (hs_mrr for Revenue Hub deals, amount for older deals), the usage limit is summed over all live won deals (an add-on deal whose limit merely repeats the license deal's limit is not counted twice) · 🟢 70–110 % · 🔵 under 70 % · 🔴 over 110 % · ⚪ no contract limit or no usage data · Features: ✅ contracted & in use · ⚠️ contracted, not in use · 🚫 in use, not in contract · ◻️ contracted, usage not measurable (App Tracking) · Status comes from the license-bearing won deal; the cancellation period is the 30 days before the license end · ↻ asks Claude for a fresh briefing (5-minute cooldown per customer), the dot marks HubSpot activity newer than the last briefing · Hits-based contracts count incoming tracking packets + outgoing requests, session-based contracts incoming sessions only · 🧪 Synthetic Users: model exists but the paid feature is off (trial / preview) · Tracking code v1 = old, blocked by browsers (upgrade!), v2 = ok, v3 = current, n/a = the DCP could not read it · Setup: a container counts as an issue only when DNS is 0 or the tracking code is neither detected nor delivering data · DCP usage data is mirrored nightly from the product database (merged HubSpot company IDs are resolved automatically).
